context:
Each helper gets its own test module. Use the existing
`test_credentials_helper.py` / `test_gcs_path.py` patterns as templates.

Mark all tests `pytest.mark.unit + pytest.mark.fast`. None of these
helpers require external services or fixtures larger than dict/string
inputs.
description:
Code review of `quality-consolidate-duplicate-code-clusters` flagged
test-coverage gaps for 5 of the 11 helpers extracted by that work.
The dedup TODO shipped tests for 2 helpers
(`test_credentials_helper.py`, `test_gcs_path.py`) but not the others.

The 5 untested helpers are exercised indirectly via adapter / family
tests, so there's no immediate behavioral risk - but isolated unit
tests catch regressions earlier and document the helper contract.

Helpers needing dedicated tests:
  - `benchbox/platforms/azure/_livy_mixin.py::LivyStatementMixin`
  - `benchbox/platforms/_spark_helpers.py::get_spark_query_plan`
  - `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/_result_helpers.py`
    (`build_success_result_dict` / `build_failure_result_dict`)
  - `benchbox/platforms/presto_trino_utils.py`
    (escape_insert_value / is_date_value / normalize_existing_files /
    load_file_batches / resolve_data_files)
  - `benchbox/core/schema_primitives.py::BaseSchemaTable`

anti_patterns.dont: bundle tests for multiple helpers into one module
modify the helper modules to make them easier to test
use mocks for things that can be tested with real values
anti_patterns.instead: only mock external boundaries (HTTP, SDK calls)

preserves.behavior: Existing tests for the 2 already-tested helpers (test_credentials_helper.py, test_gcs_path.py) - don't refactor them as part of this work
Helper module signatures unchanged - tests only, no production-code edits

verifications.description: Coverage of the 5 helper modules reaches ≥80%
verifications.expected: passed (no 'FAIL Required test coverage of 80%' line in output)

work_units.summary: Add tests for LivyStatementMixin: cover _execute_statement timing accumulation, _wait_for_statement passthrough, and the _get_headers/_ensure_session interface contract.
Add tests for get_spark_query_plan: cover normal plan capture, missing/closed connection, plan-string truncation.
Add tests for _result_helpers.build_success_result_dict / build_failure_result_dict: required-field presence, error-string handling, optional-metric defaults.
Add tests for presto_trino_utils helpers: escape_insert_value (quote/escape edges), is_date_value (date detection), normalize_existing_files, load_file_batches, resolve_data_files.
Add tests for BaseSchemaTable: schema parsing, primary-key + partitioning passthrough, CREATE TABLE statement formatting per backend hook.
